matches.preview: Arsenal are favoured at 49%, the model's strongest conviction in this opening fixture, though Aston Villa at 24% and the draw at 27% mean this is no formality. Arsenal concluded last season strongly, taking five wins from their final six matches, whereas Villa returned mixed results from that period. The most recent head-to-head fixture, in December, saw Arsenal secure a decisive 4-1 victory. The model leans marginally toward over 2.5 goals at 52%, suggesting an open match despite Arsenal's clear probabilistic edge.
matches.preview_zh: Arsenal以49%的概率被看好，這是該模型在這場開幕戰中最強的判斷，不過Aston Villa的24%和和局的27%意味著這並非既定的結果。Arsenal上賽季結束得相當出色，最後六場比賽中贏了五場，而Villa在同一時期的成績則不夠穩定。兩隊最近一次對陣是在12月，當時Arsenal以4-1的決定性比分獲勝。該模型略微傾向於超過2.5球的結果（概率為52%），這表明儘管Arsenal具有明顯的概率優勢，這場比賽仍將是一場開放式的對陣。

matches.preview: Oracle90 favours Liverpool, with a 58% chance of an away win, compared with 19% for Ipswich Town and 23% for the draw. Ipswich ended last season with one defeat in six, closing with a 3-0 home win over QPR after three draws and a win in the previous four. Liverpool’s final six league matches were less settled, bringing two wins, two draws and two defeats. Both recent meetings went their way: 2-0 away in August 2024 and 4-1 at home in January 2025. The total-goals lean is towards over 2.5 at 59%, with under 2.5 at 41%.
matches.preview_zh: Oracle90預測 Liverpool 客場獲勝的機率為58%，Ipswich Town 獲勝的機率為19%，平局機率則為23%。Ipswich 上季最後六場僅吞下一敗，最後一場在主場以3比0擊敗 QPR，此前四場取得三場平局與一場勝利。Liverpool 最後六場聯賽的表現較不穩定，取得兩勝、兩平與兩敗。近期兩次交手皆由 Liverpool 獲勝，分別是2024年8月客場以2比0取勝，以及2025年1月主場以4比1取勝。總進球數超過2.5球的機率為59%，少於2.5球的機率則為41%。

matches.preview: The model gives Newcastle United a narrow edge, with a home win at 43%, compared with 31% for Bournemouth and 26% for the draw. The match is still finely balanced. Newcastle won two of their final three home games last season, both by 3-1, but Bournemouth ended the campaign unbeaten in six matches. The visitors also have the stronger recent head-to-head record, going unbeaten across the last five meetings and winning twice, including a 2-1 victory at Newcastle in April. On total goals, the model leans towards over 2.5 at 59%, with under 2.5 at 41%.
matches.preview_zh: 模型認為 Newcastle United 略占優勢，主場獲勝機率為43%，Bournemouth 獲勝機率為31%，平局機率則為26%。這場比賽的情勢仍相當接近。Newcastle United 上賽季最後三場主場比賽贏下兩場，兩場比分都是3：1，但 Bournemouth 以連續六場不敗結束賽季。客隊近期的對戰紀錄也較佳，過去五次交手保持不敗並取得兩勝，其中包括四月作客 Newcastle United 時以2：1獲勝。總進球數方面，模型預測超過2.5球的機率為59%，低於2.5球的機率為41%。

matches.preview: Brentford are the model’s clear favourite, with a 54% home-win probability, compared with 25% for the draw and 20% for Sunderland. Brentford ended last season with two draws, including a 1-1 result away to Liverpool, while their final three home matches brought a win and two draws. Sunderland finished with successive wins over Chelsea and Everton after going four matches without a victory. The recent meetings are mixed, although Brentford won the latest 3-0 in January after Sunderland’s 2-1 success in August 2025. The total-goals forecast is evenly split: over 2.5 and under 2.5 are both 50%.
matches.preview_zh: 模型明顯看好 Brentford，其主場獲勝機率為 54%，相較之下，平局機率為 25%，Sunderland 獲勝機率為 20%。Brentford 上賽季以兩場平局作收，其中包括客場對 Liverpool 的 1 比 1，而他們最後三場主場賽事則取得一勝兩平。Sunderland 在連續四場未能取勝後，接連擊敗 Chelsea 與 Everton，結束上賽季。雙方近期交手結果各有勝負，Brentford 在最近一次於一月以 3 比 0 獲勝，此前 Sunderland 曾在 2025 年八月以 2 比 1 取勝。總進球數預測呈現均勢，超過 2．5 球與低於 2．5 球的機率均為 50%。

matches.preview: The model favours Brighton and Hove Albion, giving the home side a 55% win probability, compared with 25% for the draw and 20% for Leeds United. Brighton recorded 3-0 home wins over Wolves and Chelsea during the closing weeks of last season, although their final home match ended in a 3-0 defeat. Leeds won the most recent meeting 1-0 in May, while Brighton took the previous contest 3-0 in November 2025. That recent head-to-head record gives both sides some encouragement. For total goals, the model has a narrow lean towards over 2.5 at 52%, with under 2.5 at 48%.
matches.preview_zh: 模型較看好 Brighton and Hove Albion，認為主場球隊的獲勝機率為55%，平局機率為25%，Leeds United 的獲勝機率則為20%。上賽季最後幾週，Brighton 曾在主場分別以3比0擊敗 Wolves 與 Chelsea，但他們該賽季最後一場主場比賽以0比3落敗。Leeds 在今年5月最近一次交手中以1比0獲勝，而 Brighton 則在2025年11月的前一次對決中以3比0取勝。近期的交手紀錄都能為雙方帶來一些信心。全場總進球方面，模型認為超過2.5球的機率略高，為52%，不超過2.5球的機率則為48%。

matches.preview: Manchester City are the model’s clear favourites at home, with an 81% win probability, compared with 14% for the draw and 5% for a Coventry City win. City ended last season unevenly, taking one point from their final two matches after consecutive 3-0 home victories over Crystal Palace and Brentford. Coventry are returning to this level, so their listed Championship results are history rather than current Premier League form. That record nevertheless closed strongly, with wins of 4-0, 3-1 and 5-1 in their final three matches. There are no previous meetings on record. The total-goals forecast leans towards over 2.5 at 70%, with under 2.5 at 30%.
matches.preview_zh: 模型明確預測主場作戰的 Manchester City 較有機會獲勝，勝率為81%，平手機率為14%，Coventry City 獲勝機率為5%。City 上季末段表現不一，在主場連續以3比0擊敗 Crystal Palace 與 Brentford 後，最後兩場比賽僅取得1分。Coventry 正重返此一層級，因此列出的 Championship 賽果屬於歷史紀錄，而非目前的 Premier League 近況。儘管如此，他們仍以強勢表現結束該段賽程，最後三場分別以4比0、3比1及5比1獲勝。雙方沒有過往交手紀錄。總進球數預測較傾向超過2．5球，機率為70%，少於2．5球的機率為30%。

matches.preview: The model favours a Fulham win, but only modestly, at 43%, compared with 28% for the draw and 30% for a Crystal Palace victory. The total-goals forecast is particularly close, with a narrow lean towards under 2.5 goals at 51%.
matches.preview_zh: 模型較看好 Fulham 獲勝，但優勢不大，機率為 43%，平手為 28%，Crystal Palace 獲勝則為 30%。Fulham 上季最後一戰在主場以 2：0 擊敗 Newcastle，且最後三場主場比賽合計僅失一球。另一方面，Palace 在賽季最後六場比賽未嘗勝績，其中四場落敗。近期交手紀錄則為客隊帶來一些正面訊息，他們最近兩次作客 Fulham 均順利獲勝。總進球數的預測尤其接近，低於 2.5 球的機率略高，為 51%。

matches.preview: The match is finely balanced, with the model narrowly favouring Tottenham Hotspur at 39%, ahead of a Nottingham Forest win at 34% and the draw at 27%. The recent head-to-head record points the other way, however, as Forest won each of the last four meetings, including two 3-0 victories. The total-goals forecast is also close, with under 2.5 goals slightly preferred at 52% over 2.5 goals at 48%.
matches.preview_zh: 這場比賽勢均力敵，模型以39%略為看好 Tottenham Hotspur，其次是 Nottingham Forest 以34%獲勝，平局機率則為27%。上賽季結束前，雙方的比賽結果都好壞參半：Forest 在客場以2比3不敵 Manchester United 後，主場以1比1戰平 Bournemouth；Tottenham 則在客場以1比2敗給 Chelsea 後，以1比0擊敗 Everton。不過，近期交手紀錄呈現相反趨勢，Forest 在最近四次對決中全數獲勝，其中包括兩場以3比0取勝。全場總進球數預測也相當接近，少於2.5球的機率為52%，略高於超過2.5球的48%。

The total-goals forecast leans towards over 2.5 goals at 55%, with under 2.5 at 45%.
matches.preview_zh: 模型明確看好 Aston Villa，預測其獲勝機率為63%，Hull City 為14%，平手則為22%。Villa 上季以連續勝利作收，先在客場以2比1擊敗 Man City，再於主場以4比2擊敗 Liverpool。Hull 本季重返這個級別，因此所列的 Championship 賽果屬於上季紀錄，不能視為目前的 Premier League 表現。這段賽程以主場2比1擊敗 Norwich 告終，其中6場比賽有4場雙方都取得進球。總進球數預測方面，至少出現3球的機率為55%，最多出現2球的機率為45%。

matches.preview: Manchester United are the model’s slight favourite at 39%, but with Everton on 33% and the draw on 27%, the match is finely balanced. There is no clear total-goals lean, with over 2.5 at 50% and under 2.5 also at 50%.
matches.preview_zh: Manchester United是模型輕微看好的對象，佔39%，但Everton佔33%，和局佔27%，比賽勢均力敵。客隊以最後六場聯賽的五勝一和結束上季，包括作客對Brighton的3:0勝利。Everton則以六場不勝結束球季，其中兩場平手、四場敗績。近期交手戰績混合：Manchester United在二月於Everton主場以1:0獲勝，而Everton在十一月於Manchester United主場以相同比分勝。進球總數方面沒有明確傾向，2.5球以上佔50%，2.5球以下亦佔50%。

matches.preview_zh: Oracle90 的模型較看好主場作戰的 Arsenal，認為他們的勝率為 58%，平局機率為 24%，Chelsea 獲勝的機率則為 18%。Arsenal 在上個賽季最後六場聯賽中贏得五場，其中先連續三場以 1 比 0 獲勝，隨後以 2 比 1 擊敗 Crystal Palace。Chelsea 在最後六場比賽中輸掉四場，不過他們也曾擊敗 Tottenham，並在客場與 Liverpool 戰平。近期對戰紀錄同樣對主隊有利：Arsenal 在所列的五次交手中保持不敗，取得三勝兩平。總進球數預測幾乎勢均力敵，超過 2．5 球的機率為 51%，略高於低於 2．5 球的 49%。

matches.preview: The model favours Aston Villa at home, giving them a 53% chance of victory compared with 22% for Nottingham Forest. That is a clear but not overwhelming home lean. For total goals, the lean is towards over 2.5 at 57%, compared with 43% for under 2.5.
matches.preview_zh: 模型預測 Bournemouth 獲勝的機率為46%，和局為26%，Brentford 獲勝則為28%。Bournemouth 上季在所列的六場比賽中保持不敗，包括擊敗 Fulham、Crystal Palace 與 Newcastle。然而，近期交手紀錄較有利於 Brentford，他們在所列的近五次交鋒中贏得四場，最近一場於3月以0比0結束。這項紀錄顯示，Bournemouth 在模型中的優勢明確，但並非具有決定性，尤其 Brentford 上季最後兩場分別與 Liverpool 及 Crystal Palace 戰平。總進球數方面，模型預測超過2.5球的機率為57%，低於2.5球則為43%。

The total-goals view leans narrowly towards over 2.5 goals at 54%, against 46% for under.
